messages.subject: time series x axis breaks
parts:
I hope this is the appropriate list for this type of question

Consider the dataset below:
I have a column DOC with values from 3 to 101
and those are the values that I want to show on my x axis, however
I only get 3, 3.1, 3.2 and so on. I tried to change those values with xlim(3, 101) but I get
the following error:
Error in unit(x, default.units) : 'x' and 'units' must have length > 0

question: Which argument is needed in the ts() call to make the x axis show
breaks every 7 days starting with 3?

wt <- structure(list(DOC = c(3, 10, 17, 24, 31, 38, 45, 52, 59, 66, 
73, 80, 87, 94, 101), AvgWeight = c(1, 1.66666666666667, 2.06666666666667, 
2.275, 3.83333333333333, 6.2, 7.4, 8.5, 10.25, 11.1, 13.625, 
15.2, 16.375, 17.8, 21.5), PondName = structure(c(1L, 1L, 1L, 
1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L), .Label = "Pond01", class = "factor"), 
    SampleDate = structure(c(1182585600, 1183190400, 1183795200, 
    1184400000, 1185004800, 1185609600, 1186214400, 1186819200, 
    1187424000, 1188028800, 1188633600, 1189238400, 1189843200, 
    1190448000, 1191052800), class = c("POSIXct", "POSIXt"))), .Names = c("DOC", 
"AvgWeight", "PondName", "SampleDate"), row.names = c(NA, 15L
), class = "data.frame")  

wt$SampleDate <- as.Date(wt$SampleDate)  
wt

library(forecast)
library(ggplot2)
pond <- ts(wt$AvgWeight,start=3,frequency=52)
pond
 d.arima <- auto.arima(pond)
d.forecast <- forecast(d.arima, level = c(95), h = 3)
d.forecast


autoplot(d.forecast) + xlim(7, 101)
Error in unit(x, default.units) : 'x' and 'units' must have length > 0

Take a look at the attached plot

messages.subject: Re: time series x axis breaks
parts:
Felipe, 

I think it is the ts() call. 
str(pond)
 Time-Series [1:15] from 3 to 3.27: 1 1.67 2.07 2.27 3.83 ...

The output of it is a time series with a range of 3 to 3.27, which is what your plot is showing. Expanding that to 0,101 gives you the vertical line around 3 because that's what your data is. I've not worked with time series enough to know how to fix the ts() call. 

B

messages.author: d9fda4ad1f9acffa
messages.subject: Re: time series x axis breaks
parts:
Just in case someone is going through the same painful process, this is what I did. I was not able to find a way to create weekly breaks using ts() for my dataset, so I ended up mixing xts to create my weekly breaks and then used the forecast package to 'forecast' 3 weeks ahead.

pond <- as.xts(wt$AvgWeight,order.by=seq(as.Date("2007-06-23"), by=7, len=15))

pond
d.arima <- auto.arima(pond)
d.forecast <- forecast(d.arima, level = c(95), h = 3)
d.forecast

autoplot(d.forecast) + xlab('DOC') + ylab('AvgWeight-grs') + theme_bw()

attached is the graphic with the correct x axis labels.

I still would like to know how ts() would create the correct x axis labels
